name: Muv-Luv
source:
This game consists of two parts: Muv-Luv Extra and Muv-Luv Unlimited. Unlimited is unlocked after you get the endings of the two main heroines (Sumika and Meiya) in Extra.

Muv-Luv Extra:
Shirogane Takeru is a typical high school student with a lazy attitude and a love for the virtual reality mecha battle game Valgern-on. Even though he didn't really want it, he is popular in school mainly due to his daily fights with his osananajimi (Sumika) attracting too much attention. His life takes an unexpected turn when he finds a girl (Meiya) he doesn't remember ever meeting in his bed one morning. That girl is later revealed to be the heiress of one of the biggest zaibatsu. She immediately moves to his house and starts changing his life for the good with her one-track-mind and unlimited resources...

Muv-Luv Extra, the main part of Muv-Luv, takes place in the same world (and general area) as Kimi ga Nozomu Eien and Kimi ga Ita Kisetsu. The Sky Temple family restaurant is mentioned and visited, and Suzumiya Akane makes an appearance.

Muv-Luv Unlimited:
[spoiler]One day Takeru wakes up late, wondering why Sumika or Meiya didn't wake him up this morning. Not seeing any signs of them he gets a bit worried and goes out of his house only to see the town he lived in all his life in ruins. After getting past the initial shock he decides that this must be a dream and decides to enjoy it as much as he can...[/spoiler]

[Partially from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muv-Luv]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
游戏由两部分组成：《Muv-Luv Extra》与《Muv-Luv Unlimited》。在Extra篇中达成两名主要女主人公——纯夏与冥夜——的结局后，Unlimited篇便会解锁。

Muv-Luv Extra：
白银武是一名典型高中生，性格懒散，酷爱虚拟现实机器人对战游戏《Valgern-on》。他本人虽然无意成为焦点，却因为每天与青梅竹马鉴纯夏争吵而引来过多关注，在校内颇受欢迎。一天早晨，他在床上发现一名完全不记得见过的少女——御剑冥夜，生活由此出现意想不到的转折。后来，武得知冥夜是某个巨型财阀的继承人。她立刻搬进武的家中，凭一根筋的作风和取之不尽的资源，开始将他的生活推向“更好”的方向……

作为《Muv-Luv》的主要部分，Extra篇与《你所期望的永远》《你所在的季节》处于同一世界及相近地区。故事会提及并造访家庭餐厅“Sky Temple”，凉宫茜也将登场。

Muv-Luv Unlimited：
[spoiler]一天，武睡过了头，疑惑纯夏或冥夜今天早晨为何没有叫醒他。始终不见两人的踪影，他渐渐担心起来，走出家门，却发现自己从小生活的城镇已经化为废墟。熬过最初的震惊后，他认定这一切肯定是一场梦，决定尽可能享受其中……[/spoiler]

[部分内容摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muv-Luv]维基百科[/url]]
